request: can you make a porch light switch? one button that turns the light on and off, and i want it to stay that way when i come back
design_rationale: A switch is glanced at and tapped, so one centred card with the heading, a clear on/off line and a single button whose label names the next action; neutral base with an amber accent.

verify.steps: Open the page, see the light is off, click Turn on, see it is on, reload and still see on, click Turn off, see it is off.

why.services/lamp.jac: Lamp node holding the on/off bool; read_lamp reads it and flip_lamp inverts it, both creating the node under root on first use.
why.components/PorchPanel.jac: The whole screen: the Porch light heading, the on/off line with a loading state, and the Turn on / Turn off button.
why.main.jac: Registers the lamp endpoints, loads global.css and renders the panel.

write_reasoning.services/lamp.jac: Backend first: one Lamp node under root, created on first use by a private _lamp helper. flip_lamp returns the new value so the client never re-reads through the cached read_lamp.
write_reasoning.components/PorchPanel.jac: read_lamp is awaited once in async can with entry, and handle_flip is async because it awaits flip_lamp. The state is set from the value flip_lamp returns, since a def:pub read is cached and would come back stale.
write_reasoning.main.jac: Last, main.jac imports read_lamp and flip_lamp from services.lamp with no leading dot so both endpoints are registered on the server, then renders the panel.

plan_call_reasoning: Plan the build: one screen with one saved on/off value, so a single component and a tiny server.
plan_reasoning: One screen: a heading, the light status and a toggle button. The bool lives on one node under root behind two def:pub functions; the client loads it on mount and takes the new value from flip_lamp. main.jac last.
plan_summary: Build plan: a single-screen porch light switch, 4 files leaf-first, the bool on one server node via read_lamp and flip_lamp.
journal:
# Agent journal

## Issues
- A def:pub read is cached on the client on jac 0.34.28, so read_lamp is called only on mount and the screen shows the value flip_lamp returns.

## Learnings
- One node under root, found with [root-->][?:Lamp] and created on first use, keeps a single bool across reloads.

## Last Action
Built Porch light: a heading, the on/off line loaded from the server, and a Turn on / Turn off button that saves each click.
final:
Porch light is running: it shows whether the light is on or off, and the button flips it on the server. I turned it on, reloaded and it was still on, then turned it off.

**Next steps**
- Add a dimmer level
- Show when it was last switched
- Add more lights
